name: Thai Pongal & Mattu Pongal
description: Tamil harvest festival celebrating the Sun God with freshly boiled sweet Pongal, sugarcane, turmeric plants, and colourful kolam decorations across Mylapore and Chengalpattu hamlets.
travel_tip: Visit Mylapore Mada Streets or Chengalpattu heritage villages to experience traditional earthen pot cooking over woodfires.

name: Thaipusam at Vadapalani & Thiruporur
description: Grand festival honoring Lord Murugan with colorful Kavadi Aattam dances, milk pot processions, and devotional chants across Vadapalani and Thiruporur Shrines.
travel_tip: Witness the sea of yellow-clad devotees carrying flower kavadis at Vadapalani Murugan Temple.

name: Margazhi Music & Dance Season
description: World's largest cultural festival featuring over 2,000 Carnatic vocal concerts, Bharatanatyam recitals, and traditional sabha tiffin canteens in Chennai.
travel_tip: Visit Music Academy and Narada Gana Sabha for morning lectures and evening vocal concerts accompanied by hot Ghee Roast Dosa.

name: Mylapore Festival & Kolam Competition
description: Four-day street festival around Kapaleeshwarar Temple featuring street theatre, traditional crafts, folk music, and 100+ intricate rice powder kolam competitions.
travel_tip: Walk North Mada Street at 6 AM to see women draw elaborate geometric kolams spanning entire street blocks.

name: Mamallapuram Indian Dance Festival
description: Month-long beachfront cultural festival held against the open-air backdrop of 7th-century rock reliefs at Arjuna's Penance in Mahabalipuram.
travel_tip: Attend weekend evening shows under the starry sky right after exploring the Shore Temple.

name: Thiruporur Murugan Temple Ther Vizha
description: Annual temple chariot procession carrying Lord Kandaswamy through the historic temple streets of Thiruporur in Chengalpattu district.
travel_tip: Join local villagers pulling the decorated wooden chariot along OSRM coastal road.

name: Panguni Uthiram Ther Vizha at Mylapore
description: Celestial wedding anniversary of Lord Kapaleeshwarar & Goddess Karpagambal celebrated with a massive 40-foot wooden temple chariot procession.
travel_tip: Visit Mylapore Kapaleeshwarar Temple early in the morning to see the giant wooden chariot pulled by thousands of devotees.

name: Triplicane Parthasarathy Temple Chariot Festival
description: 10-day Brahmotsavam festival featuring the historic silver vehicle (Velli Garuda Sevai) and chariot processions in 8th-century Triplicane.
travel_tip: Arrive at 5:30 AM for the morning Garuda Sevai procession around Car Street.

name: Aadi Perukku at Muttukadu & ECR Shores
description: Monsoon river & water body festival giving thanks for life-giving water, featuring family picnics, variety rice dishes, and floating lamp offerings along Muttukadu and ECR shores.
travel_tip: Join local families along Muttukadu backwaters to taste traditional lemon and tamarind rice.

name: Covelong Point Surf & Music Festival
description: International surfing competition, beach volleyball, live indie music bands, and food stalls along the Kovalam coastline in Chengalpattu.
travel_tip: Watch national surf athletes ride morning waves before attending sunset beach acoustic sets.

name: Vedanthangal Bird Sanctuary Arrival Season
description: Annual homecoming of 30,000+ migratory birds from Siberia and Australasia to the Barringtonia mangrove tank in Vedanthangal.
travel_tip: Bring telephoto cameras at 7:00 AM for soft morning light on pelican nests.

name: San Thome Basilica Christmas & New Year Feast
description: Illuminated festive midnight mass, choir carols, and beachside festivities at the 16th-century Neo-Gothic cathedral built over St. Thomas' tomb.
travel_tip: Attend the Christmas Eve midnight carol service for soaring organ acoustic hymns.
